utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So, how much are the club membership dues this month?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’m not sure offhand, but I can check when I’m out running errands and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Ira — could you let me know as soon as you find out?

utterances.speaker: Gus

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Uh, I’m not totally sure on the amount yet — I think it was posted up somewhere. I’ll check and get back to you on when it’s due.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: No worries — just let me know when you find it, and I can sort it out from there.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the dues went up a bit this month, but I’m not sure why yet. If you want, I can ask around and see what’s going on.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That would be great, thanks. I just want to make sure I understand the change before I pay.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sure thing — I’ll ask around and let you know what I find out.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — I’m happy to help with the dues. What would you like to know?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Sam — could you remind me where the dues should be paid and how much they are?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Of course — you can pay the dues at the clubhouse desk, and they’re $20 per month.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Uli, I’m happy to pass along the club dues info or help sort out who’s paid already.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Quinn. If you could send me the dues info, I’d appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Sure thing—I’ll send you the dues info right away. If you want, I can also help check who’s already paid.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Leo — I’m just checking in on the club dues. If it’s easier, I can help sort out the payment details.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Rosa — I can send the dues today. If you could text me the payment details, that’d help.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Of course, Leo — I’ll text you the payment details right now. Thanks for taking care of it today.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you remind me of the exact dues amount and when it’s due? I want to make sure I have the details right before we do anything.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m not sure of the exact amount offhand, but I can check and get back to you right away. I’ll make sure you have the due date too.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Dane — please check and send me both the exact amount and the due date when you can.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can sort the dues around the school schedule—what’s the amount and when does Mara need it by?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Faye — it’s $20, and I’d need it by Friday if that works.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yes, that works—I’ll send $20 in by Friday and keep it around the school pickup time.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I heard the dues were changing, but I’m not sure on the details yet. Did you get the latest update from the club?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I haven’t gotten the latest update yet, but I can check and let you know. If you hear anything first, fill me in too.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, I appreciate it — I’ll do the same if I hear anything first.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I skimmed the dues info — what’s the amount and when do you need it?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm the exact amount and the due date?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I don’t have the exact numbers in front of me — can you resend the dues amount and due date?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can check the dues amount and let you know what I find.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, thanks, Rey — I’d really appreciate that. I keep mixing up the numbers, so that helps a lot.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: No problem, Oren. I’ll check and get back to you soon.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I can remind everyone about the dues and circle back with the exact plan.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Vik — that’d really help. Let me know once you’ve got the exact plan, and I’ll keep track of who’s paid.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll remind everyone about the dues and get the exact plan sorted, then I’ll circle back to you.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, right — did the club dues go up again, or are we still on the same amount?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Still the same as far as I know — I haven’t heard of any change.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Good to know. I’ll keep an ear out in case they mention anything at the next meeting.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — the club dues. I can check what I still owe and get it to you soon.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — just let me know what you owe, and I’ll keep the club updated.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Vik — I’ll look it over and tell you as soon as I know.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right—the club dues. I think I missed the update; what’s the amount again?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: It’s $20 for the month. If you want, I can send the payment details.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Leo—send me the payment details and I’ll take care of it.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yeah, I can lend a hand if you need it—want me to help figure out the dues?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Yes, please—let’s keep it simple and go over the dues step by step.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — let’s start with the total dues, then we can split it up into each person’s share.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Quinn — I’m happy to help with the club dues. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Mara — could you send your dues amount when you’re ready, and I’ll pass it along to the club?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Sure — my dues amount is $25. Thanks for passing it along to the club!

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sure thing — I can help sort out the dues details. What part do you want to go over?

utterances.speaker: Opal

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can check who’s collecting them this month and where they’re being taken. If you want, I’ll ask around and get you the exact details.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Cleo, I’m just checking in on the club membership dues—have you had a chance to look them over?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hi Rosa — I haven’t looked them over yet, but I can check today and let you know what I find.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Cleo — I appreciate it. Just let me know when you’ve had a chance to review them.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard the dues went up a bit—do you know if that’s for everyone, or just new members?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I’m not sure yet—do you know if they mentioned it in the last club notice?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I only heard it second-hand, so I’m not sure. I’ll check the last notice and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, right — what’re the dues again?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: They’re $20 for the semester, and I can send the exact details if you want.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it, $20 works for me — send the details when you can.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure, Kira — I can help with the club dues. What’s the amount and how would you like to handle it?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, what’s the exact amount and when do you need it by?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I don’t have the exact amount in front of me right now, but I can check and get back to you soon. Once I confirm it, I’ll let you know the deadline too.
